Yes, it has happened, and it's the usual pattern. A design agent draws the new boards and marks the old ones sitting next to them. Older boards of the same screen on another page or in another row get missed. I found four confirmed cases. The session that drew the new boards never caught any of them; you or a sweep you ordered did.

**How I checked.** Sessions had saved 36 copies of the canvas index locally, from 1 November to today. I compared each copy with the one before it to see when boards were added and whether a superseded note came with them. That gave 8 batches of new boards. Four of them only added new screens or states, so there was nothing to mark. The other four replaced older boards:

- **The JusPrin 1 welcome-back window (around 1 November).** The credits session redrew this window as credits-01c and 01d. The three older boards (onboarding-v1-01 to 03) got no note. You found them through a canvas comment on 5 November: "Do we still keep this?"
- **The first-run welcome (3 November).** The session marked the whole onboarding wizard superseded in the same publish. It missed credits-01b, an older welcome screen on the same page. The sweep you ordered found it on 7 November.
- **The Plan and billing boards (6 November).** The session marked the two old pricing-page boards. It missed credits-04a, 04b and 04c, the old Account boards on the Agent setup & Preferences page. On 7 November you couldn't find them, and you couldn't tell which version was current until a session showed you both sets.

**The three boards**

Version 150 has two new orange notes, each placed right next to its boards. I read it back: compared with version 149, the only change is those two notes.

- **credits-07a and 07b (the savings alert, Compositions page).** I labelled these "Outdated", not "Superseded". The reason is that no newer board draws the alert line above the composer. The note says what's wrong with them: "Pay as you go" is now "No plan" (money-06), and the alert's on/off choice moved from Preferences › Account to the Credit pack card (money-03).
- **main-08 (Home after first launch, Main Page).** I marked it "Superseded" by first-run-09 and 10. The note also says credits-01a still draws main-08 as the Home screen behind Preferences.

I also stopped this session's comment watch on the canvas, so it won't reply to comments meant for other sessions.

**Where the rule could go**

The obvious document is the "Design handoff requirements" list in [design-system.md](agent-docs/jusprin/design-system.md:336). It already holds nine rules every board must meet, and rule 9 is already canvas housekeeping: draw a shared piece once on the Compositions page.

That document has a gap, though. A design session started in the JusPrin folder sees it, because [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) points to it. Several of the canvas sessions this week ran in `claude_cowork_wd`, which has no CLAUDE.md, so they never saw any JusPrin document. The one thing every canvas session reads, whatever folder it starts in, is the canvas index, `canvas.json`.

Here's my proposal. None of this is written yet.

1. **Add two rules to that list in design-system.md**:
   - A new board that replaces an older one means checking every page for older boards of the same screen. Each one gets a "Superseded" note beside it, on its own page, naming the newer board. If nothing newer draws that screen, the note says "Outdated" and lists what's wrong.
   - Update the boards first and show you, then write the code.
2. **Put the same two rules in one canvas note** at the top of the first page, so sessions outside the JusPrin folder see them too.

The doc edit is small, and it goes on the working branch, ui-walkthrough. The note is one canvas publish. My pick is both, because the second covers the sessions the first can't reach.
